    def propose_deobfuscation_fixes(self) -> str:
        """Queue local, deterministic deobfuscation fixes from the last Binary Triage (no model, no tokens).

        API-hash comments, ``p_<API>`` renames of resolved-pointer globals, decoded-string
        comments and anti-disassembly / opaque-branch byte patches. Everything is a PENDING
        proposal in Proposed Changes; nothing is written until the analyst approves it, and
        every applied change (patches included) can be rolled back. UI thread.
        """
        from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis import deobfuscation_fixes as fixes
        from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.ida.code_reader import collect_patch_inputs, read_comment_and_names

        from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.ida.code_reader import collect_full_code_signals

        signals = getattr(self._previous_triage, "code_signals", None)
        seed = self._last_triage
        if signals is None and seed is None:
            return "Run Binary Triage first: deobfuscation fixes are built from its code signals"
        modules = load_ida_modules()
        # Whole-binary pass over the application's own code only: runtime, standard-library,
        # third-party and compiler-generated functions (code-origin index) are never scanned or patched.
        functions = [item for item in (getattr(seed, "functions", ()) or ())
                     if getattr(item, "origin", "unknown") in ANALYSABLE_ORIGINS and not item.is_thunk
                     and not item.is_library and item.size >= 16]
        functions.sort(key=lambda item: (item.origin != "author", item.address))
        if functions:
            try:
                full = self._run_on_ida_thread(
                    lambda: collect_full_code_signals(modules, [(item.address, item.name) for item in functions]), "MFF_READ")
                if full is not None:
                    signals = full
            except Exception as exc:  # fall back to the triage scan
                log_event(self._logger, "deobfuscation_full_scan_failed", error=_log_value(repr(exc)))
        if signals is None:
            return "Run Binary Triage first: deobfuscation fixes are built from its code signals"
        scanned = len(tuple(getattr(signals, "scanned_addresses", ()) or ()))
        proposals: List[Any] = fixes.hash_proposals(signals) + fixes.decoded_string_proposals(signals)
        try:
            inputs = self._run_on_ida_thread(lambda: collect_patch_inputs(modules, tuple(signals.scanned_addresses)), "MFF_READ")
        except Exception as exc:
            inputs = []
            log_event(self._logger, "deobfuscation_scan_failed", error=_log_value(repr(exc)))
        patch_count = 0
        for start, name, data, heads in inputs:
            found = fixes.find_byte_patches(start, data, heads)[: max(0, fixes.MAX_PATCHES - patch_count)]
            patch_count += len(found)
            proposals.extend(fixes.patch_proposals(name, found))

        comment_eas = [item.address for item in proposals if item.operation == "add_comment"]
        name_eas = [item.address for item in proposals if item.operation == "rename_global"]
        wanted = [candidate for item in proposals if item.operation == "rename_global"
                  for candidate in [item.value] + ["{0}_{1}".format(item.value, n) for n in range(2, 10)]]
        comments, names, taken = self._run_on_ida_thread(
            lambda: read_comment_and_names(modules, comment_eas, name_eas, wanted), "MFF_READ")

        counts: Dict[str, int] = {}
        skipped = 0
        used_names: Set[str] = set()
        for item in proposals:
            value = item.value
            if item.operation == "add_comment":
                merged = fixes.merge_comment(comments.get(item.address), value)
                if merged is None:
                    skipped += 1
                    continue
                comments[item.address] = merged  # several comments at one address stack up
                value = merged
            elif item.operation == "rename_global":
                if not fixes.is_default_name(names.get(item.address)):
                    skipped += 1  # never overwrite a name the analyst (or a previous fix) chose
                    continue
                choice = next((candidate for candidate in [value] + ["{0}_{1}".format(value, n) for n in range(2, 10)]
                               if not taken.get(candidate) and candidate not in used_names), None)
                if choice is None:
                    skipped += 1
                    continue
                used_names.add(choice)
                value = choice
            if self._already_pending(item.operation, item.address, value):
                skipped += 1
                continue
            try:
                self.propose_change(item.operation, item.address, value, reason=item.reason, evidence=item.evidence,
                                    confidence=item.confidence, source="deobfuscation", metadata=item.metadata or None)
            except (ValueError, RuntimeError) as exc:
                skipped += 1  # e.g. the pointer global is not defined as data yet, or bytes changed
                log_event(self._logger, "deobfuscation_fix_skipped", operation=item.operation,
                          address=hex(item.address), reason=_log_value(str(exc)))
                continue
            counts[item.kind] = counts.get(item.kind, 0) + 1
        self._panel_refresh_changes()
        total = sum(counts.values())
        log_event(self._logger, "deobfuscation_fixes_proposed", total=total, skipped=skipped, **counts)
        scope = " across {0} of {1} application function(s) (library / runtime / compiler code excluded)".format(
            scanned, len(functions) or scanned)
        if not total:
            return "No new deobfuscation fixes found{0} ({1} skipped as already applied, pending or not writable)".format(scope, skipped)
        labels = (("api_hash_comment", "API-hash comment(s)"), ("api_pointer_name", "pointer rename(s)"),
                  ("decoded_string", "decoded-string comment(s)"), ("patch", "byte patch(es)"))
        parts = ["{0} {1}".format(counts[key], label) for key, label in labels if counts.get(key)]
        return "Queued {0} deobfuscation fix(es){1}: {2}{3}. Review and approve them in Proposed Changes.".format(
            total, scope, ", ".join(parts), "; {0} skipped".format(skipped) if skipped else "")

    # -- action runner ------------------------------------------------------

    def is_running(self) -> bool:
        return self._running_kind is not None

104	def _hash_tables() -> Dict[str, Dict[int, str]]:
105	    global _HASH_TABLES
106	    if _HASH_TABLES is not None:
107	        return _HASH_TABLES
108	    tables: Dict[str, Dict[int, str]] = {}
109	    # The catalogue lists "dll!Function"; hash the function part (and, for ROR13, the pair).
110	    pairs: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
111	    for entry in deob.known_api_names():
112	        if not entry or not entry.isascii():
113	            continue
114	        dll, _, func = entry.rpartition("!")
115	        pairs.append((dll or "kernel32.dll", func))
116	    dlls = [dll for dll in deob.known_dll_names() if dll.isascii()]
117	    for algorithm in deob.HASH_ALGORITHMS:
118	        table: Dict[int, str] = {}
119	        for dll, func in pairs:
120	            for variant in dict.fromkeys((func, func.lower(), func.upper())):
121	                try:
122	                    table.setdefault(deob.hash_name(variant, algorithm), dll + "!" + func)
123	                except deob.DeobfuscationInputError:
124	                    continue
125	            if algorithm == "ror13":
126	                # Metasploit-style hashes combine the module name with the function name
127	                # (upper-cased module name in the original; some loaders lower-case it).
128	                for module in dict.fromkeys([dll] + dlls):
129	                    for case in ("upper", "lower"):
130	                        try:
131	                            table.setdefault(deob.hash_api(module, func, "ror13", case), module + "!" + func)
132	                        except deob.DeobfuscationInputError:
133	                            continue
134	        tables[algorithm] = {value: name for value, name in table.items() if value not in _HASH_IGNORE and value > 0xFFFF}
135	    _HASH_TABLES = tables
136	    return tables

246	def _anti_analysis(parsed: Sequence[deob.ParsedInstruction], raw: Sequence[Instruction]) -> List[Tuple[int, str]]:
247	    found: List[Tuple[int, str]] = []
248	    seen: Set[str] = set()
249	    # A timing check reads the counter twice and compares; one rdtsc is entropy (e.g. a stack cookie).
250	    rdtsc_count = sum(1 for item in parsed if item.mnemonic in ("rdtsc", "rdtscp"))
251	    for index, item in enumerate(parsed):
252	        text = (raw[index].text or "").split(";", 1)[0].strip().lower()
253	        for label, pattern in _ANTI_PATTERNS:
254	            if label in seen:
255	                continue
256	            if label == "rdtsc timing check" and rdtsc_count < 2:
257	                continue
258	            if pattern.search(text):
259	                if label.startswith("PEB access"):
260	                    # Only a PEB read followed by a debug-flag field is an anti-debug check.
261	                    window = " ".join((entry.text or "").lower() for entry in raw[index:index + 4])
262	                    if not any(offset in window.replace(" ", "") for offset in _PEB_DEBUG_OFFSETS):
263	                        continue
264	                    label = "PEB BeingDebugged / NtGlobalFlag check"
265	                    if label in seen:
266	                        continue
267	                found.append((item.address, label))
268	                seen.add(label)
269	        if item.mnemonic == "cpuid" and "cpuid hypervisor probe" not in seen:
270	            window = parsed[max(0, index - 4):index]
271	            values = [deob.parse_immediate(op) for entry in window if entry.mnemonic == "mov" for op in entry.operands[1:]]
272	            if any(value in _CPUID_HYPERVISOR for value in values if value is not None):
273	                found.append((item.address, "cpuid hypervisor probe"))
274	                seen.add("cpuid hypervisor probe")
275	        if item.mnemonic == "mov" and "VMware backdoor magic 'VMXh'" not in seen:
276	            if any(deob.parse_immediate(op) == _VMWARE_MAGIC for op in item.operands[1:]):
277	                found.append((item.address, "VMware backdoor magic 'VMXh'"))
278	                seen.add("VMware backdoor magic 'VMXh'")
279	    return found

282	_RESULT_REGISTERS = frozenset({"rax", "eax"})
283	POINTER_STORE_WINDOW = 14
284	
285	
286	def _pointer_stores(parsed: Sequence[deob.ParsedInstruction], memory_operands: Mapping[int, Sequence[int]],
287	                    candidate_eas: Set[int]) -> Dict[int, int]:
288	    """Hash instruction -> global written with the resolver's return value.
289	
290	    Pattern (both bitnesses): the hash constant is loaded or pushed, a call
291	    follows, and the call's result (``rax``/``eax``) is stored to a global
292	    within a few instructions: ``mov ecx, 0x726774C`` / ``call resolve`` /
293	    ``mov cs:qword_140012345, rax``.
294	    """
295	    stores: Dict[int, int] = {}
296	    for index, item in enumerate(parsed):
297	        if item.address not in candidate_eas:
298	            continue
299	        seen_call = False
300	        for follower in parsed[index + 1: index + 1 + POINTER_STORE_WINDOW]:
301	            if follower.mnemonic == "call":
302	                if seen_call:
303	                    break  # a second call without a store: not the resolver pattern
304	                seen_call = True
305	                continue
306	            if not seen_call:
307	                continue
308	            operands = [operand.strip().lower() for operand in follower.operands]
309	            # The reader records only memory operands that point at real data (> 0x1000),
310	            # so stack stores ("mov [rbp+var_8], rax") never qualify.
311	            targets = list(memory_operands.get(follower.address, ()))
312	            if follower.mnemonic == "mov" and len(operands) == 2 and operands[1] in _RESULT_REGISTERS and targets:
313	                stores[item.address] = targets[0]
314	                break
315	            if operands and operands[0] in _RESULT_REGISTERS:
316	                break  # the result register is overwritten before any store
317	    return stores

320	def analyse_function(
321	    address: int,
322	    name: str,
323	    instructions: Sequence[Instruction],
324	    memory_operands: Mapping[int, Sequence[int]] = {},
325	    read_bytes: Optional[Callable[[int, int], Optional[bytes]]] = None,
326	    is_data_address: Optional[Callable[[int], bool]] = None,
327	) -> Tuple[FunctionSignals, List[Tuple[int, int]]]:
328	    """Signals of one function plus raw (instruction address, immediate) hash candidates.
329	
330	    ``memory_operands`` maps an instruction address to the data addresses its
331	    operands reference (from IDA); with ``read_bytes`` it lets XOR loops be
332	    decoded from their real buffer.
333	    """
334	    items = tuple(instructions)[: deob.MAX_OUTPUT_ITEMS]
335	    parsed = [deob.parse_instruction(item) for item in items]
336	    decoded: List[Tuple[int, str, str]] = []
337	    for stack in deob.extract_stack_strings(items):
338	        method = getattr(stack, "method", "")
339	        decoded.append((stack.start_address, stack.text,
340	                        "stack string ({0}{1})".format(stack.encoding, ", " + method if method else "")))
341	
342	    if read_bytes is not None:
343	        for loop in deob.detect_xor_loop(items):
344	            if loop.key_hint is None or not 0 < (loop.key_hint & 0xFFFFFFFF) <= 0xFF:
345	                continue
346	            buffers = [target for ea in range(loop.start_address - 64, loop.end_address + 1)
347	                       for target in memory_operands.get(ea, ()) if is_data_address is None or is_data_address(target)]
348	            for buffer in dict.fromkeys(buffers):
349	                raw = read_bytes(buffer, 512)
350	                if not raw:
351	                    continue
352	                plain = deob.decode_xor(raw, bytes([loop.key_hint & 0xFF]))
353	                text = plain.split(b"\x00", 1)[0]
354	                # A key applied to an empty / unrelated buffer gives "kkkk…" or noise: require real text.
355	                if len(text) >= 4 and deob.printable_ratio(text) >= 0.95 and deob.looks_like_text(text.decode("latin-1")):
356	                    decoded.append((buffer, text.decode("latin-1"), "single-byte XOR 0x{0:02X} (loop 0x{1:X})".format(loop.key_hint & 0xFF, loop.start_address)))
357	                    break
358	
359	    crypto: List[Tuple[int, str]] = []
360	    candidates: List[Tuple[int, int]] = []
361	    seen_crypto: Set[str] = set()
362	    for ea, value, mnemonic in _immediates(parsed):
363	        label = CRYPTO_IMMEDIATES.get(value)
364	        if label is not None and label not in seen_crypto:
365	            crypto.append((ea, label))
366	            seen_crypto.add(label)
367	        elif mnemonic in ("cmp", "mov", "push", "xor", "sub", "add", "test") and value > 0xFFFF and value not in _HASH_IGNORE:
368	            candidates.append((ea, value))
369	    if any(item.mnemonic == "ror" and any(deob.parse_immediate(op) == 13 for op in item.operands[1:]) for item in parsed):
370	        crypto.append((next(item.address for item in parsed if item.mnemonic == "ror"), "ROR-13 hashing loop (API hashing)"))
371	
372	    stores = _pointer_stores(parsed, memory_operands, {ea for ea, _value in candidates})
373	    helper = is_runtime_helper(name)
374	    signals = FunctionSignals(
375	        address=address,
376	        name=name,
377	        decoded_strings=tuple(dict.fromkeys(decoded)),
378	        crypto=tuple(crypto),
379	        anti_analysis=() if helper else tuple(_anti_analysis(parsed, items)),
380	        # Every candidate's store for now; build_code_signals keeps only the resolved ones.
381	        pointer_stores=tuple(sorted(stores.items())),
382	        pe_walk=() if helper else _pe_walk(parsed),
383	    )
384	    return signals, candidates

387	_EXPORT_DIR = re.compile(r"\+\s*(?:0x)?(?:78|88)h?\]")
388	_LFANEW = re.compile(r"\+\s*(?:0x)?3ch?\]")
389	# IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY: NumberOfNames +18h, AddressOfFunctions +1Ch, AddressOfNames +20h, AddressOfNameOrdinals +24h.
390	_EXPORT_FIELDS = {offset: re.compile(r"\+\s*(?:0x)?{0}h?\]".format(offset)) for offset in ("18", "1c", "20", "24")}

393	def _pe_walk(parsed: Sequence[deob.ParsedInstruction]) -> Tuple[Tuple[int, str], ...]:
394	    """Export-table walking without the import table.
395	
396	    Needs the export-directory read (``[nt+78h]`` PE32 / ``[nt+88h]`` PE32+) and either an
397	    ``MZ`` / ``PE`` signature compare, or an ``e_lfanew`` (``+3Ch``) read plus at least three of
398	    the export-directory fields (+18h/+1Ch/+20h/+24h) - a combination ordinary structures do not
399	    produce. The CRT's own image checks compare MZ/PE but never read the export directory.
400	    """
401	    export = signature = lfanew = None
402	    fields = set()
403	    for item in parsed:
404	        # Stack slots ([rsp+78h], [ebp+20h]) share these offsets; PE structures are reached through a
405	        # module-base register, never the frame.
406	        operands = " ".join(op for op in item.operands if not re.search(r"\[(?:[er]?[sb]p)\b", op))
407	        if export is None and _EXPORT_DIR.search(operands) and item.mnemonic in ("mov", "add", "lea"):
408	            export = item.address
409	        if lfanew is None and _LFANEW.search(operands) and item.mnemonic in ("mov", "add", "movsxd", "lea"):
410	            lfanew = item.address
411	        if item.mnemonic in ("mov", "add", "lea", "movzx", "cmp"):
412	            fields.update(offset for offset, pattern in _EXPORT_FIELDS.items() if pattern.search(operands))
413	        if signature is None and item.mnemonic == "cmp" and len(item.operands) == 2:
414	            value = deob.parse_immediate(item.operands[1])
415	            if value in (0x5A4D, 0x4550) or item.operands[1] in ("'zm'", "'mz'", "'ep'"):
416	                signature = item.address
417	    # The export directory's own fields must be read: a signature compare alone is what the CRT's
418	    # image checks and delay-load helpers do too.
419	    if export is None or len(fields) < 3 or (signature is None and lfanew is None):
420	        return ()
421	    found = [(export, "export directory read (e_lfanew+78h/88h)")]
422	    if signature is not None:
423	        found.append((signature, "MZ / PE signature compare"))
424	    if lfanew is not None:
425	        found.append((lfanew, "e_lfanew (+3Ch) read"))
426	    return tuple(found)

429	def resolve_hashes(
430	    candidates_by_function: Mapping[int, Sequence[Tuple[int, int]]], minimum_hits: int = 2
431	) -> Tuple[Optional[str], Dict[int, List[Tuple[int, int, str, str]]]]:
432	    """Pick the hash algorithm with the most matches (>= ``minimum_hits``) and resolve with it."""
433	    tables = _hash_tables()
434	    best: Optional[str] = None
435	    best_hits = 0
436	    for algorithm, table in tables.items():
437	        hits = {value for candidates in candidates_by_function.values() for _ea, value in candidates if value in table}
438	        if len(hits) > best_hits:
439	            best, best_hits = algorithm, len(hits)
440	    if best is None or best_hits < minimum_hits:
441	        return None, {}
442	    table = tables[best]
443	    resolved: Dict[int, List[Tuple[int, int, str, str]]] = {}
444	    for function, candidates in candidates_by_function.items():
445	        for ea, value in candidates:
446	            api = table.get(value)
447	            if api is not None:
448	                entries = resolved.setdefault(function, [])
449	                if all(entry[1] != value for entry in entries):
450	                    entries.append((ea, value, best, api))
451	    return best, resolved

454	# Data hash tables: minimum distinct catalogue hits for an algorithm, gap allowed inside one table
455	# (unknown entries, padding), and the scan budget.
456	MIN_TABLE_HASH_HITS = 6
457	TABLE_MAX_GAP_BYTES = 16
458	MAX_HASH_SCAN_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024
459	_HASH_INDEX: Optional[Dict[int, Tuple[Tuple[str, str], ...]]] = None

462	def _hash_index() -> Dict[int, Tuple[Tuple[str, str], ...]]:
463	    """hash value -> ((algorithm, "dll!Function"), ...) over every algorithm (built once)."""
464	    global _HASH_INDEX
465	    if _HASH_INDEX is None:
466	        index: Dict[int, List[Tuple[str, str]]] = {}
467	        for algorithm, table in _hash_tables().items():
468	            for value, api in table.items():
469	                index.setdefault(value, []).append((algorithm, api))
470	        _HASH_INDEX = {value: tuple(items) for value, items in index.items()}
471	    return _HASH_INDEX

474	def find_hash_tables(
475	    blobs: Sequence[Tuple[int, bytes]],
476	    references_to: Optional[Callable[[int], Sequence[int]]] = None,
477	    minimum_hits: int = MIN_TABLE_HASH_HITS,
478	) -> Tuple[Optional[str], Tuple[HashTable, ...]]:
479	    """Find API-hash tables in data: aligned dwords that match one algorithm's catalogue hashes.
480	
481	    The algorithm with the most *distinct* hits wins (>= ``minimum_hits``); its hits are grouped
482	    into tables (gaps up to ``TABLE_MAX_GAP_BYTES``) and each table is linked to the functions
483	    that reference any of its entries (``references_to(address)`` -> function starts).
484	    """
485	    index = _hash_index()
486	    hits: List[Tuple[int, int, Tuple[Tuple[str, str], ...]]] = []
487	    budget = MAX_HASH_SCAN_BYTES
488	    for start, blob in blobs:
489	        if not blob or budget <= 0:
490	            continue
491	        data = bytes(blob[: budget])
492	        budget -= len(data)
493	        usable = len(data) - (len(data) % 4)
494	        for offset in range(0, usable, 4):
495	            value = int.from_bytes(data[offset: offset + 4], "little")
496	            found = index.get(value)
497	            if found:
498	                hits.append((start + offset, value, found))
499	    counts: Dict[str, set] = {}
500	    for _address, value, found in hits:
501	        for algorithm, _api in found:
502	            counts.setdefault(algorithm, set()).add(value)
503	    if not counts:
504	        return None, ()
505	    algorithm = max(counts, key=lambda name: (len(counts[name]), name))
506	    if len(counts[algorithm]) < minimum_hits:
507	        return None, ()
508	    chosen = [(address, value, next(api for alg, api in found if alg == algorithm))
509	              for address, value, found in hits if any(alg == algorithm for alg, _api in found)]
510	    tables: List[HashTable] = []
511	    run: List[Tuple[int, int, str]] = []
512	
513	    def close() -> None:
514	        if len(run) >= 2:
515	            start, end = run[0][0], run[-1][0] + 4
516	            functions: List[int] = []
517	            if references_to is not None:
518	                for address in range(max(0, start - TABLE_MAX_GAP_BYTES), end, 4):
519	                    for function in references_to(address) or ():
520	                        if function not in functions:
521	                            functions.append(function)
522	            tables.append(HashTable(start, end, algorithm, tuple(run), (end - start) // 4 - len(run), tuple(functions)))
523	        del run[:]
524	
525	    for entry in chosen:
526	        if run and entry[0] - run[-1][0] > TABLE_MAX_GAP_BYTES:
527	            close()
528	        run.append(entry)
529	    close()
530	    return algorithm, tuple(tables)
531	
532	
533	PARALLEL_STORE_WINDOW = 12
534	
535	
536	def parallel_table_stores(
537	    instructions: Sequence[Instruction], memory_operands: Mapping[int, Sequence[int]], table: HashTable,
538	) -> Dict[int, int]:
539	    """Map each hash-table entry to the global its resolved pointer is stored in.
540	
541	    Resolver loops read ``hash[i]`` and write ``ptr[i]`` with the same index:
542	    ``mov ecx, [esi+HASHES]`` ... ``mov [esi+POINTERS], eax``. Every load whose data
543	    target lies in ``table`` starts a sub-table; the first following store to another
544	    data address within ``PARALLEL_STORE_WINDOW`` instructions gives its pointer base.
545	    Pointer slots are 8 bytes when the store scales the index by 8, else 4.
546	    """
547	    parsed = [deob.parse_instruction(item) for item in instructions]
548	    loads: List[Tuple[int, int, int]] = []   # (sub-table start, pointer base, pointer size)
549	    for index, item in enumerate(parsed):
550	        targets = [value for value in memory_operands.get(item.address, ()) if table.start <= value < table.end]
551	        if not targets or item.mnemonic not in ("mov", "cmp", "push", "lea"):
552	            continue
553	        source = targets[0]
554	        for follower in parsed[index + 1: index + 1 + PARALLEL_STORE_WINDOW]:
555	            if follower.mnemonic != "mov" or len(follower.operands) != 2:
556	                continue
557	            destination, value = follower.operands
558	            if deob._is_register(destination) or not deob._is_register(value):
559	                continue
560	            stores = [target for target in memory_operands.get(follower.address, ())
561	                      if not table.start <= target < table.end]
562	            if stores:
563	                loads.append((source, stores[0], 8 if "*8" in destination else 4))
564	                break
565	    if not loads:
566	        return {}
567	    loads.sort()
568	    mapping: Dict[int, int] = {}
569	    for position, (source, base, size) in enumerate(loads):
570	        limit = loads[position + 1][0] if position + 1 < len(loads) else table.end
571	        for ea, _value, _api in table.entries:
572	            if source <= ea < limit:
573	                mapping[ea] = base + (ea - source) // 4 * size
574	    return mapping
575	
576	
577	def build_code_signals(
578	    functions: Sequence[Tuple[int, str, Sequence[Instruction], Mapping[int, Sequence[int]]]],
579	    read_bytes: Optional[Callable[[int, int], Optional[bytes]]] = None,
580	    is_data_address: Optional[Callable[[int], bool]] = None,
581	    tables: Sequence[Tuple[int, str, Tuple[int, ...]]] = (),
582	    data_blobs: Sequence[Tuple[int, bytes]] = (),
583	    references_to: Optional[Callable[[int], Sequence[int]]] = None,
584	) -> CodeSignals:
585	    """Analyse every supplied function and attach data-table hits to the functions that reference them.
586	
587	    ``data_blobs`` (``(start, bytes)`` of non-executable segments) enables the API-hash table
588	    scan; ``references_to(address)`` returns the functions that reference a data address.
589	    """
590	    per_function: Dict[int, FunctionSignals] = {}
591	    candidates: Dict[int, List[Tuple[int, int]]] = {}
592	    for address, name, instructions, memory in functions:
593	        signals, hash_candidates = analyse_function(address, name, instructions, memory, read_bytes, is_data_address)
594	        per_function[address] = signals
595	        if hash_candidates:
596	            candidates[address] = hash_candidates
597	    algorithm, resolved = resolve_hashes(candidates)
598	    for address in list(per_function):
599	        current = per_function[address]
600	        entries = tuple(resolved.get(address, ()))
601	        resolved_eas = {entry[0] for entry in entries}
602	        per_function[address] = replace(current, api_hashes=entries,
603	                                        pointer_stores=tuple(item for item in current.pointer_stores if item[0] in resolved_eas))
604	    table_algorithm, hash_tables = find_hash_tables(data_blobs, references_to) if data_blobs else (None, ())
605	    code_of = {address: (instructions, memory) for address, _name, instructions, memory in functions}
606	    for table in hash_tables:
607	        owners = [function for function in table.functions if function in per_function] or [table.start]
608	        for owner in owners:
609	            current = per_function.get(owner) or FunctionSignals(owner, "hash table @0x{0:X}".format(table.start))
610	            known = {entry[1] for entry in current.api_hashes}
611	            added = tuple((ea, value, table.algorithm, api) for ea, value, api in table.entries if value not in known)
612	            stores: Tuple[Tuple[int, int], ...] = ()
613	            if owner in code_of:
614	                instructions, memory = code_of[owner]
615	                stores = tuple(sorted(parallel_table_stores(instructions, memory, table).items()))
616	            per_function[owner] = replace(current, api_hashes=current.api_hashes + added,
617	                                          pointer_stores=current.pointer_stores + stores)
618	    if table_algorithm and table_algorithm != algorithm:
619	        algorithm = table_algorithm if algorithm is None else "{0} + {1} (data tables)".format(algorithm, table_algorithm)
620	    for table_address, label, referencing in tables:
621	        for function in referencing:
622	            current = per_function.get(function)
623	            if current is None:
624	                continue
625	            if all(existing[1] != label for existing in current.crypto):
626	                per_function[function] = replace(current, crypto=current.crypto + ((table_address, label),))
627	    scanned = tuple(address for address, _name, _instructions, _memory in functions)
628	    return CodeSignals(
629	        functions=tuple(item for item in per_function.values() if not item.empty),
630	        hash_algorithm=algorithm,
631	        tables=tuple(tables),
632	        scanned_functions=len(scanned),
633	        scanned_addresses=scanned,
634	        hash_tables=hash_tables,
635	    )
636	
637	
638	def format_code_signals(signals: Optional[CodeSignals], limit: int = 8) -> str:
639	    """Compact Triage-tab block (one line per function, strongest first)."""
640	    if signals is None or not signals.scanned_functions:
641	        return ""
642	    if not signals.functions:
643	        return "Code signals: {0} author function(s) scanned - no decoders, API hashing, crypto constants or anti-analysis instructions.".format(
644	            signals.scanned_functions)
645	    lines = ["Code signals ({0} author function(s) scanned{1}):".format(
646	        signals.scanned_functions, ", API hash algorithm " + signals.hash_algorithm if signals.hash_algorithm else "")]
647	    tables = getattr(signals, "hash_tables", ()) or ()
648	    if tables:
649	        apis = sum(len(table.entries) for table in tables)
650	        dlls = list(dict.fromkeys(entry[2].split("!", 1)[0] for table in tables for entry in table.entries))
651	        lines.append("  API hash tables in data: {0} table(s), {1} API(s) from {2} ({3}) at {4}".format(
652	            len(tables), apis, ", ".join(dlls[:8]), tables[0].algorithm,
653	            ", ".join("0x{0:X}".format(table.start) for table in tables[:6])))
654	
655	    def weight(item: FunctionSignals) -> Tuple[int, int]:
656	        return (-(3 * len(item.api_hashes) + 3 * len(item.anti_analysis) + 2 * len(item.decoded_strings) + len(item.crypto)), item.address)
657	
658	    for item in sorted(signals.functions, key=weight)[:limit]:
659	        parts = []
660	        if item.api_hashes:
661	            parts.append("resolves {0}".format(", ".join(entry[3].split("!", 1)[-1] for entry in item.api_hashes[:4])))
662	        if item.anti_analysis:
663	            parts.append("; ".join(entry[1] for entry in item.anti_analysis[:3]))
664	        if item.decoded_strings:
665	            parts.append("decodes " + ", ".join('"{0}"'.format(entry[1][:40]) for entry in item.decoded_strings[:3]))
666	        if item.crypto:
667	            parts.append(", ".join(dict.fromkeys(entry[1] for entry in item.crypto[:3])))
668	        lines.append("  0x{0:X}  {1:<30} {2}".format(item.address, item.name[:30], " | ".join(parts)))
669	    if len(signals.functions) > limit:
670	        lines.append("  … {0} more function(s) with signals".format(len(signals.functions) - limit))
671	    return "\n".join(lines)
672	
673	
674	__all__ = [
675	    "CRYPTO_IMMEDIATES", "CRYPTO_TABLES", "CodeSignals", "FunctionSignals", "analyse_function", "build_code_signals",
676	    "format_code_signals", "resolve_hashes",

"""Deterministic per-function code signals for Binary Triage (no model).

For each *author* function (``analysis/code_origin``) the IDA adapter
(``ida/code_reader.py``) supplies its disassembly; this module turns it into:

* **decoded strings** - stack strings (``deobfuscation.extract_stack_strings``)
  and single-byte XOR loops whose key and data buffer are both visible;
* **resolved API hashes** - 32-bit immediates matched against pre-computed
  ROR13 / CRC32 / DJB2 / FNV-1a / SDBM / Murmur3 hashes of the known-API
  catalogue (a match needs >= 2 hits with the same algorithm in the binary);
* **crypto constants** - algorithm-specific immediates (TEA, SHA-1/2, MD5,
  ChaCha/Salsa, CRC32, Blowfish, RC5/6, MT19937, FNV, Murmur) plus data
  tables found by the adapter (AES S-boxes, CRC32 table, Base64 alphabet);
* **anti-analysis instructions** - ``rdtsc``, ``cpuid`` hypervisor leaf,
  PEB ``BeingDebugged`` / ``NtGlobalFlag`` reads, ``int 2d``, ``icebp``,
  the VMware backdoor port, ``sidt``/``sgdt``/``sldt``/``str`` (red pill).

Everything is pure Python over ``core.context.Instruction`` objects plus
optional operand values; identical input gives identical output.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
from typing import Callable, Dict, FrozenSet, List, Mapping, Optional, Sequence, Set, Tuple

from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis import deobfuscation as deob
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.core.context import Instruction

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Crypto constants
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CRYPTO_IMMEDIATES: Dict[int, str] = {
    0x9E3779B9: "TEA/XTEA/XXTEA delta (also golden-ratio hashing)",
    0x61C88647: "TEA delta (negated)",
    0x67452301: "MD5/SHA-1 initial state",
    0xEFCDAB89: "MD5/SHA-1 initial state",
    0x98BADCFE: "MD5/SHA-1 initial state",
    0x10325476: "MD5/SHA-1 initial state",
    0xC3D2E1F0: "SHA-1 initial state",
    0xD76AA478: "MD5 round constant",
    0x5A827999: "SHA-1 round constant",
    0x6ED9EBA1: "SHA-1 round constant",
    0x6A09E667: "SHA-256 initial state",
    0xBB67AE85: "SHA-256 initial state",
    0x428A2F98: "SHA-256 round constant",
    0x61707865: "ChaCha/Salsa20 'expa' constant",
    0x3320646E: "ChaCha/Salsa20 'nd 3' constant",
    0x79622D32: "ChaCha/Salsa20 '2-by' constant",
    0x6B206574: "ChaCha/Salsa20 'te k' constant",
    0xEDB88320: "CRC32 polynomial (reflected)",
    0x04C11DB7: "CRC32 polynomial",
    0x82F63B78: "CRC32C polynomial",
    0x243F6A88: "Blowfish P-array / pi constant",
    0xB7E15163: "RC5/RC6 P constant",
    0x6C078965: "MT19937 initialisation multiplier",
    0x811C9DC5: "FNV-1 offset basis",
    0x01000193: "FNV prime",
    0xCC9E2D51: "Murmur3 constant",
    0x1B873593: "Murmur3 constant",
    0x5BD1E995: "MurmurHash2 constant",
    0x000343FD: "MSVC rand() LCG multiplier",
    0x41C64E6D: "glibc rand() LCG multiplier",
}
# Data tables the adapter searches for in non-executable segments.
CRYPTO_TABLES: Tuple[Tuple[bytes, str], ...] = (
    (bytes.fromhex("637c777bf26b6fc53001672bfed7ab76"), "AES S-box"),
    (bytes.fromhex("52096ad53036a538bf40a39e81f3d7fb"), "AES inverse S-box"),
    (bytes.fromhex("a56363c6847c7cf8997777ee8d7b7bf6"), "AES T-table (Te0)"),
    (bytes.fromhex("0000000096300777"), "CRC32 lookup table"),
    (b"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/", "Base64 alphabet"),
    (bytes.fromhex("d1310ba698dfb5ac2ffd72dbd01adfb7"), "Blowfish S-box"),
    (bytes.fromhex("2ef3cf6c01010101"), "DES/3DES table (partial)"),
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Anti-analysis instruction patterns (over lower-cased disassembly text)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_ANTI_PATTERNS: Tuple[Tuple[str, "re.Pattern[str]"], ...] = (
    ("rdtsc timing check", re.compile(r"^rdtscp?\b")),
    ("int 2Dh debugger trap", re.compile(r"^int\s+2dh?\b")),
    ("icebp / int1 trap", re.compile(r"^(?:icebp|int1)\b")),
    ("red-pill descriptor-table probe (sidt/sgdt/sldt/str)", re.compile(r"^(?:sidt|sgdt|sldt|str)\b")),
    ("VMware backdoor I/O port", re.compile(r"^in\s+e?ax,\s*dx\b")),
    ("PEB access via fs:[30h]", re.compile(r"\bfs:(?:\[)?(?:0?30h|\[?30h\]?|large\s+30h)")),
    ("PEB access via gs:[60h]", re.compile(r"\bgs:(?:\[)?(?:0?60h|\[?60h\]?|large\s+60h)")),
    ("KUSER_SHARED_DATA read (0x7FFE0000)", re.compile(r"7ffe0[0-9a-f]{3}h")),
)
_CPUID_HYPERVISOR = frozenset({0x40000000, 0x40000001, 1})
_VMWARE_MAGIC = 0x564D5868  # 'VMXh'
_PEB_DEBUG_OFFSETS = ("+2]", "+2h]", "+68h]", "+0bch]", "+0bc h]", "+18h]")  # BeingDebugged, NtGlobalFlag (32/64), ProcessHeap

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# API hash tables (built once, lazily)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_HASH_TABLES: Optional[Dict[str, Dict[int, str]]] = None
_HASH_IGNORE: FrozenSet[int] = frozenset(CRYPTO_IMMEDIATES) | frozenset({0xFFFFFFFF, 0x7FFFFFFF, 0x80000000, 0xCCCCCCCC, 0xDEADBEEF})


def _hash_tables() -> Dict[str, Dict[int, str]]:
    global _HASH_TABLES
    if _HASH_TABLES is not None:
        return _HASH_TABLES
    tables: Dict[str, Dict[int, str]] = {}
    # The catalogue lists "dll!Function"; hash the function part (and, for ROR13, the pair).
    pairs: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
    for entry in deob.known_api_names():
        if not entry or not entry.isascii():
            continue
        dll, _, func = entry.rpartition("!")
        pairs.append((dll or "kernel32.dll", func))
    dlls = [dll for dll in deob.known_dll_names() if dll.isascii()]
    for algorithm in deob.HASH_ALGORITHMS:
        table: Dict[int, str] = {}
        for dll, func in pairs:
            for variant in dict.fromkeys((func, func.lower(), func.upper())):
                try:
                    table.setdefault(deob.hash_name(variant, algorithm), dll + "!" + func)
                except deob.DeobfuscationInputError:
                    continue
            if algorithm == "ror13":
                # Metasploit-style hashes combine the module name with the function name
                # (upper-cased module name in the original; some loaders lower-case it).
                for module in dict.fromkeys([dll] + dlls):
                    for case in ("upper", "lower"):
                        try:
                            table.setdefault(deob.hash_api(module, func, "ror13", case), module + "!" + func)
                        except deob.DeobfuscationInputError:
                            continue
        tables[algorithm] = {value: name for value, name in table.items() if value not in _HASH_IGNORE and value > 0xFFFF}
    _HASH_TABLES = tables
    return tables


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Results
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FunctionSignals:
    address: int
    name: str
    decoded_strings: Tuple[Tuple[int, str, str], ...] = ()  # (address, text, method)
    api_hashes: Tuple[Tuple[int, int, str, str], ...] = ()   # (instruction address, value, algorithm, api)
    crypto: Tuple[Tuple[int, str], ...] = ()                 # (address, description)
    anti_analysis: Tuple[Tuple[int, str], ...] = ()          # (address, description)
    #: (hash instruction address, global that receives the resolved pointer) - only for resolved hashes.
    pointer_stores: Tuple[Tuple[int, int], ...] = ()
    #: Manual PE parsing: (address, description) - export-directory walking without the import table.
    pe_walk: Tuple[Tuple[int, str], ...] = ()

    @property
    def empty(self) -> bool:
        return not (self.decoded_strings or self.api_hashes or self.crypto or self.anti_analysis or self.pe_walk)

    @property
    def kinds(self) -> Tuple[str, ...]:
        output = []
        if self.decoded_strings:
            output.append("decoder")
        if self.api_hashes:
            output.append("api_hashing")
        if self.crypto:
            output.append("crypto")
        if self.anti_analysis:
            output.append("anti_analysis")
        if self.pe_walk:
            output.append("api_hashing")  # same role for ranking: resolves APIs without imports
        return tuple(output)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class HashTable:
    """A run of API hashes stored as data (e.g. ``dd 67765186h, 0EA5988BEh, ...`` walked by a resolver loop)."""

    start: int
    end: int
    algorithm: str
    entries: Tuple[Tuple[int, int, str], ...]   # (entry address, hash value, "dll!Function")
    unresolved: int                             # dwords inside the run not in the catalogue
    functions: Tuple[int, ...] = ()             # functions that reference the table


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CodeSignals:
    functions: Tuple[FunctionSignals, ...] = ()
    hash_algorithm: Optional[str] = None
    tables: Tuple[Tuple[int, str, Tuple[int, ...]], ...] = ()  # (table address, description, referencing functions)
    scanned_functions: int = 0
    #: Start addresses of every scanned author function (with or without signals).
    scanned_addresses: Tuple[int, ...] = ()
    #: API-hash tables found in data segments.
    hash_tables: Tuple[HashTable, ...] = ()

    def for_function(self, address: int) -> Optional[FunctionSignals]:
        for item in self.functions:
            if item.address == address:
                return item
        return None

    @property
    def resolved_apis(self) -> Tuple[str, ...]:
        names: List[str] = []
        for item in self.functions:
            for _ea, _value, _algorithm, api in item.api_hashes:
                bare = api.split("!", 1)[-1]
                if bare not in names:
                    names.append(bare)
        return tuple(names)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Per-function analysis
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _immediates(parsed: Sequence[deob.ParsedInstruction]) -> List[Tuple[int, int, str]]:
    output = []
    for item in parsed:
        for operand in item.operands:
            value = deob.parse_immediate(operand.replace("offset ", ""))
            if value is not None:
                output.append((item.address, value & 0xFFFFFFFF, item.mnemonic))
    return output


# Compiler runtime / loader-helper functions (named from PDB symbols or FLIRT) that legitimately read
# PE headers, export tables and the time-stamp counter: their code says nothing about the author.
_RUNTIME_HELPER = re.compile(
    r"(?i)delayload|delayimp|__scrt|_initterm|nonwritable|findpesection|validateimagebase|security_init_cookie|"
    r"__get_entropy|_rtc_|__acrt|__vcrt|__crt_|report_gs|_except_handler|__chkstk|_guard_|dyn_tls|"
    r"resolvedelay|__pfnDliNotifyHook|tracelogging|wil::|wil_|_tlgWrite|telemetry|"
    r"getprocaddressforcaller|apisetquery|__isa_available|cpu_feature"
)


def is_runtime_helper(name: str) -> bool:
    return bool(name) and bool(_RUNTIME_HELPER.search(name))


def _anti_analysis(parsed: Sequence[deob.ParsedInstruction], raw: Sequence[Instruction]) -> List[Tuple[int, str]]:
    found: List[Tuple[int, str]] = []
    seen: Set[str] = set()
    # A timing check reads the counter twice and compares; one rdtsc is entropy (e.g. a stack cookie).
    rdtsc_count = sum(1 for item in parsed if item.mnemonic in ("rdtsc", "rdtscp"))
    for index, item in enumerate(parsed):
        text = (raw[index].text or "").split(";", 1)[0].strip().lower()
        for label, pattern in _ANTI_PATTERNS:
            if label in seen:
                continue
            if label == "rdtsc timing check" and rdtsc_count < 2:
                continue
            if pattern.search(text):
                if label.startswith("PEB access"):
                    # Only a PEB read followed by a debug-flag field is an anti-debug check.
                    window = " ".join((entry.text or "").lower() for entry in raw[index:index + 4])
                    if not any(offset in window.replace(" ", "") for offset in _PEB_DEBUG_OFFSETS):
                        continue
                    label = "PEB BeingDebugged / NtGlobalFlag check"
                    if label in seen:
                        continue
                found.append((item.address, label))
                seen.add(label)
        if item.mnemonic == "cpuid" and "cpuid hypervisor probe" not in seen:
            window = parsed[max(0, index - 4):index]
            values = [deob.parse_immediate(op) for entry in window if entry.mnemonic == "mov" for op in entry.operands[1:]]
            if any(value in _CPUID_HYPERVISOR for value in values if value is not None):
                found.append((item.address, "cpuid hypervisor probe"))
                seen.add("cpuid hypervisor probe")
        if item.mnemonic == "mov" and "VMware backdoor magic 'VMXh'" not in seen:
            if any(deob.parse_immediate(op) == _VMWARE_MAGIC for op in item.operands[1:]):
                found.append((item.address, "VMware backdoor magic 'VMXh'"))
                seen.add("VMware backdoor magic 'VMXh'")
    return found


_RESULT_REGISTERS = frozenset({"rax", "eax"})
POINTER_STORE_WINDOW = 14


def _pointer_stores(parsed: Sequence[deob.ParsedInstruction], memory_operands: Mapping[int, Sequence[int]],
                    candidate_eas: Set[int]) -> Dict[int, int]:
    """Hash instruction -> global written with the resolver's return value.

    Pattern (both bitnesses): the hash constant is loaded or pushed, a call
    follows, and the call's result (``rax``/``eax``) is stored to a global
    within a few instructions: ``mov ecx, 0x726774C`` / ``call resolve`` /
    ``mov cs:qword_140012345, rax``.
    """
    stores: Dict[int, int] = {}
    for index, item in enumerate(parsed):
        if item.address not in candidate_eas:
            continue
        seen_call = False
        for follower in parsed[index + 1: index + 1 + POINTER_STORE_WINDOW]:
            if follower.mnemonic == "call":
                if seen_call:
                    break  # a second call without a store: not the resolver pattern
                seen_call = True
                continue
            if not seen_call:
                continue
            operands = [operand.strip().lower() for operand in follower.operands]
            # The reader records only memory operands that point at real data (> 0x1000),
            # so stack stores ("mov [rbp+var_8], rax") never qualify.
            targets = list(memory_operands.get(follower.address, ()))
            if follower.mnemonic == "mov" and len(operands) == 2 and operands[1] in _RESULT_REGISTERS and targets:
                stores[item.address] = targets[0]
                break
            if operands and operands[0] in _RESULT_REGISTERS:
                break  # the result register is overwritten before any store
    return stores


def analyse_function(
    address: int,
    name: str,
    instructions: Sequence[Instruction],
    memory_operands: Mapping[int, Sequence[int]] = {},
    read_bytes: Optional[Callable[[int, int], Optional[bytes]]] = None,
    is_data_address: Optional[Callable[[int], bool]] = None,
) -> Tuple[FunctionSignals, List[Tuple[int, int]]]:
    """Signals of one function plus raw (instruction address, immediate) hash candidates.

    ``memory_operands`` maps an instruction address to the data addresses its
    operands reference (from IDA); with ``read_bytes`` it lets XOR loops be
    decoded from their real buffer.
    """
    items = tuple(instructions)[: deob.MAX_OUTPUT_ITEMS]
    parsed = [deob.parse_instruction(item) for item in items]
    decoded: List[Tuple[int, str, str]] = []
    for stack in deob.extract_stack_strings(items):
        method = getattr(stack, "method", "")
        decoded.append((stack.start_address, stack.text,
                        "stack string ({0}{1})".format(stack.encoding, ", " + method if method else "")))

    if read_bytes is not None:
        for loop in deob.detect_xor_loop(items):
            if loop.key_hint is None or not 0 < (loop.key_hint & 0xFFFFFFFF) <= 0xFF:
                continue
            buffers = [target for ea in range(loop.start_address - 64, loop.end_address + 1)
                       for target in memory_operands.get(ea, ()) if is_data_address is None or is_data_address(target)]
            for buffer in dict.fromkeys(buffers):
                raw = read_bytes(buffer, 512)
                if not raw:
                    continue
                plain = deob.decode_xor(raw, bytes([loop.key_hint & 0xFF]))
                text = plain.split(b"\x00", 1)[0]
                # A key applied to an empty / unrelated buffer gives "kkkk…" or noise: require real text.
                if len(text) >= 4 and deob.printable_ratio(text) >= 0.95 and deob.looks_like_text(text.decode("latin-1")):
                    decoded.append((buffer, text.decode("latin-1"), "single-byte XOR 0x{0:02X} (loop 0x{1:X})".format(loop.key_hint & 0xFF, loop.start_address)))
                    break

    crypto: List[Tuple[int, str]] = []
    candidates: List[Tuple[int, int]] = []
    seen_crypto: Set[str] = set()
    for ea, value, mnemonic in _immediates(parsed):
        label = CRYPTO_IMMEDIATES.get(value)
        if label is not None and label not in seen_crypto:
            crypto.append((ea, label))
            seen_crypto.add(label)
        elif mnemonic in ("cmp", "mov", "push", "xor", "sub", "add", "test") and value > 0xFFFF and value not in _HASH_IGNORE:
            candidates.append((ea, value))
    if any(item.mnemonic == "ror" and any(deob.parse_immediate(op) == 13 for op in item.operands[1:]) for item in parsed):
        crypto.append((next(item.address for item in parsed if item.mnemonic == "ror"), "ROR-13 hashing loop (API hashing)"))

    stores = _pointer_stores(parsed, memory_operands, {ea for ea, _value in candidates})
    helper = is_runtime_helper(name)
    signals = FunctionSignals(
        address=address,
        name=name,
        decoded_strings=tuple(dict.fromkeys(decoded)),
        crypto=tuple(crypto),
        anti_analysis=() if helper else tuple(_anti_analysis(parsed, items)),
        # Every candidate's store for now; build_code_signals keeps only the resolved ones.
        pointer_stores=tuple(sorted(stores.items())),
        pe_walk=() if helper else _pe_walk(parsed),
    )
    return signals, candidates


_EXPORT_DIR = re.compile(r"\+\s*(?:0x)?(?:78|88)h?\]")
_LFANEW = re.compile(r"\+\s*(?:0x)?3ch?\]")
# IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY: NumberOfNames +18h, AddressOfFunctions +1Ch, AddressOfNames +20h, AddressOfNameOrdinals +24h.
_EXPORT_FIELDS = {offset: re.compile(r"\+\s*(?:0x)?{0}h?\]".format(offset)) for offset in ("18", "1c", "20", "24")}


def _pe_walk(parsed: Sequence[deob.ParsedInstruction]) -> Tuple[Tuple[int, str], ...]:
    """Export-table walking without the import table.

    Needs the export-directory read (``[nt+78h]`` PE32 / ``[nt+88h]`` PE32+) and either an
    ``MZ`` / ``PE`` signature compare, or an ``e_lfanew`` (``+3Ch``) read plus at least three of
    the export-directory fields (+18h/+1Ch/+20h/+24h) - a combination ordinary structures do not
    produce. The CRT's own image checks compare MZ/PE but never read the export directory.
    """
    export = signature = lfanew = None
    fields = set()
    for item in parsed:
        # Stack slots ([rsp+78h], [ebp+20h]) share these offsets; PE structures are reached through a
        # module-base register, never the frame.
        operands = " ".join(op for op in item.operands if not re.search(r"\[(?:[er]?[sb]p)\b", op))
        if export is None and _EXPORT_DIR.search(operands) and item.mnemonic in ("mov", "add", "lea"):
            export = item.address
        if lfanew is None and _LFANEW.search(operands) and item.mnemonic in ("mov", "add", "movsxd", "lea"):
            lfanew = item.address
        if item.mnemonic in ("mov", "add", "lea", "movzx", "cmp"):
            fields.update(offset for offset, pattern in _EXPORT_FIELDS.items() if pattern.search(operands))
        if signature is None and item.mnemonic == "cmp" and len(item.operands) == 2:
            value = deob.parse_immediate(item.operands[1])
            if value in (0x5A4D, 0x4550) or item.operands[1] in ("'zm'", "'mz'", "'ep'"):
                signature = item.address
    # The export directory's own fields must be read: a signature compare alone is what the CRT's
    # image checks and delay-load helpers do too.
    if export is None or len(fields) < 3 or (signature is None and lfanew is None):
        return ()
    found = [(export, "export directory read (e_lfanew+78h/88h)")]
    if signature is not None:
        found.append((signature, "MZ / PE signature compare"))
    if lfanew is not None:
        found.append((lfanew, "e_lfanew (+3Ch) read"))
    return tuple(found)


def resolve_hashes(
    candidates_by_function: Mapping[int, Sequence[Tuple[int, int]]], minimum_hits: int = 2
) -> Tuple[Optional[str], Dict[int, List[Tuple[int, int, str, str]]]]:
    """Pick the hash algorithm with the most matches (>= ``minimum_hits``) and resolve with it."""
    tables = _hash_tables()
    best: Optional[str] = None
    best_hits = 0
    for algorithm, table in tables.items():
        hits = {value for candidates in candidates_by_function.values() for _ea, value in candidates if value in table}
        if len(hits) > best_hits:
            best, best_hits = algorithm, len(hits)
    if best is None or best_hits < minimum_hits:
        return None, {}
    table = tables[best]
    resolved: Dict[int, List[Tuple[int, int, str, str]]] = {}
    for function, candidates in candidates_by_function.items():
        for ea, value in candidates:
            api = table.get(value)
            if api is not None:
                entries = resolved.setdefault(function, [])
                if all(entry[1] != value for entry in entries):
                    entries.append((ea, value, best, api))
    return best, resolved


# Data hash tables: minimum distinct catalogue hits for an algorithm, gap allowed inside one table
# (unknown entries, padding), and the scan budget.
MIN_TABLE_HASH_HITS = 6
TABLE_MAX_GAP_BYTES = 16
MAX_HASH_SCAN_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024
_HASH_INDEX: Optional[Dict[int, Tuple[Tuple[str, str], ...]]] = None


def _hash_index() -> Dict[int, Tuple[Tuple[str, str], ...]]:
    """hash value -> ((algorithm, "dll!Function"), ...) over every algorithm (built once)."""
    global _HASH_INDEX
    if _HASH_INDEX is None:
        index: Dict[int, List[Tuple[str, str]]] = {}
        for algorithm, table in _hash_tables().items():
            for value, api in table.items():
                index.setdefault(value, []).append((algorithm, api))
        _HASH_INDEX = {value: tuple(items) for value, items in index.items()}
    return _HASH_INDEX


def find_hash_tables(
    blobs: Sequence[Tuple[int, bytes]],
    references_to: Optional[Callable[[int], Sequence[int]]] = None,
    minimum_hits: int = MIN_TABLE_HASH_HITS,
) -> Tuple[Optional[str], Tuple[HashTable, ...]]:
    """Find API-hash tables in data: aligned dwords that match one algorithm's catalogue hashes.

    The algorithm with the most *distinct* hits wins (>= ``minimum_hits``); its hits are grouped
    into tables (gaps up to ``TABLE_MAX_GAP_BYTES``) and each table is linked to the functions
    that reference any of its entries (``references_to(address)`` -> function starts).
    """
    index = _hash_index()
    hits: List[Tuple[int, int, Tuple[Tuple[str, str], ...]]] = []
    budget = MAX_HASH_SCAN_BYTES
    for start, blob in blobs:
        if not blob or budget <= 0:
            continue
        data = bytes(blob[: budget])
        budget -= len(data)
        usable = len(data) - (len(data) % 4)
        for offset in range(0, usable, 4):
            value = int.from_bytes(data[offset: offset + 4], "little")
            found = index.get(value)
            if found:
                hits.append((start + offset, value, found))
    counts: Dict[str, set] = {}
    for _address, value, found in hits:
        for algorithm, _api in found:
            counts.setdefault(algorithm, set()).add(value)
    if not counts:
        return None, ()
    algorithm = max(counts, key=lambda name: (len(counts[name]), name))
    if len(counts[algorithm]) < minimum_hits:
        return None, ()
    chosen = [(address, value, next(api for alg, api in found if alg == algorithm))
              for address, value, found in hits if any(alg == algorithm for alg, _api in found)]
    tables: List[HashTable] = []
    run: List[Tuple[int, int, str]] = []

    def close() -> None:
        if len(run) >= 2:
            start, end = run[0][0], run[-1][0] + 4
            functions: List[int] = []
            if references_to is not None:
                for address in range(max(0, start - TABLE_MAX_GAP_BYTES), end, 4):
                    for function in references_to(address) or ():
                        if function not in functions:
                            functions.append(function)
            tables.append(HashTable(start, end, algorithm, tuple(run), (end - start) // 4 - len(run), tuple(functions)))
        del run[:]

    for entry in chosen:
        if run and entry[0] - run[-1][0] > TABLE_MAX_GAP_BYTES:
            close()
        run.append(entry)
    close()
    return algorithm, tuple(tables)


PARALLEL_STORE_WINDOW = 12


def parallel_table_stores(
    instructions: Sequence[Instruction], memory_operands: Mapping[int, Sequence[int]], table: HashTable,
) -> Dict[int, int]:
    """Map each hash-table entry to the global its resolved pointer is stored in.

    Resolver loops read ``hash[i]`` and write ``ptr[i]`` with the same index:
    ``mov ecx, [esi+HASHES]`` ... ``mov [esi+POINTERS], eax``. Every load whose data
    target lies in ``table`` starts a sub-table; the first following store to another
    data address within ``PARALLEL_STORE_WINDOW`` instructions gives its pointer base.
    Pointer slots are 8 bytes when the store scales the index by 8, else 4.
    """
    parsed = [deob.parse_instruction(item) for item in instructions]
    loads: List[Tuple[int, int, int]] = []   # (sub-table start, pointer base, pointer size)
    for index, item in enumerate(parsed):
        targets = [value for value in memory_operands.get(item.address, ()) if table.start <= value < table.end]
        if not targets or item.mnemonic not in ("mov", "cmp", "push", "lea"):
            continue
        source = targets[0]
        for follower in parsed[index + 1: index + 1 + PARALLEL_STORE_WINDOW]:
            if follower.mnemonic != "mov" or len(follower.operands) != 2:
                continue
            destination, value = follower.operands
            if deob._is_register(destination) or not deob._is_register(value):
                continue
            stores = [target for target in memory_operands.get(follower.address, ())
                      if not table.start <= target < table.end]
            if stores:
                loads.append((source, stores[0], 8 if "*8" in destination else 4))
                break
    if not loads:
        return {}
    loads.sort()
    mapping: Dict[int, int] = {}
    for position, (source, base, size) in enumerate(loads):
        limit = loads[position + 1][0] if position + 1 < len(loads) else table.end
        for ea, _value, _api in table.entries:
            if source <= ea < limit:
                mapping[ea] = base + (ea - source) // 4 * size
    return mapping


def build_code_signals(
    functions: Sequence[Tuple[int, str, Sequence[Instruction], Mapping[int, Sequence[int]]]],
    read_bytes: Optional[Callable[[int, int], Optional[bytes]]] = None,
    is_data_address: Optional[Callable[[int], bool]] = None,
    tables: Sequence[Tuple[int, str, Tuple[int, ...]]] = (),
    data_blobs: Sequence[Tuple[int, bytes]] = (),
    references_to: Optional[Callable[[int], Sequence[int]]] = None,
) -> CodeSignals:
    """Analyse every supplied function and attach data-table hits to the functions that reference them.

    ``data_blobs`` (``(start, bytes)`` of non-executable segments) enables the API-hash table
    scan; ``references_to(address)`` returns the functions that reference a data address.
    """
    per_function: Dict[int, FunctionSignals] = {}
    candidates: Dict[int, List[Tuple[int, int]]] = {}
    for address, name, instructions, memory in functions:
        signals, hash_candidates = analyse_function(address, name, instructions, memory, read_bytes, is_data_address)
        per_function[address] = signals
        if hash_candidates:
            candidates[address] = hash_candidates
    algorithm, resolved = resolve_hashes(candidates)
    for address in list(per_function):
        current = per_function[address]
        entries = tuple(resolved.get(address, ()))
        resolved_eas = {entry[0] for entry in entries}
        per_function[address] = replace(current, api_hashes=entries,
                                        pointer_stores=tuple(item for item in current.pointer_stores if item[0] in resolved_eas))
    table_algorithm, hash_tables = find_hash_tables(data_blobs, references_to) if data_blobs else (None, ())
    code_of = {address: (instructions, memory) for address, _name, instructions, memory in functions}
    for table in hash_tables:
        owners = [function for function in table.functions if function in per_function] or [table.start]
        for owner in owners:
            current = per_function.get(owner) or FunctionSignals(owner, "hash table @0x{0:X}".format(table.start))
            known = {entry[1] for entry in current.api_hashes}
            added = tuple((ea, value, table.algorithm, api) for ea, value, api in table.entries if value not in known)
            stores: Tuple[Tuple[int, int], ...] = ()
            if owner in code_of:
                instructions, memory = code_of[owner]
                stores = tuple(sorted(parallel_table_stores(instructions, memory, table).items()))
            per_function[owner] = replace(current, api_hashes=current.api_hashes + added,
                                          pointer_stores=current.pointer_stores + stores)
    if table_algorithm and table_algorithm != algorithm:
        algorithm = table_algorithm if algorithm is None else "{0} + {1} (data tables)".format(algorithm, table_algorithm)
    for table_address, label, referencing in tables:
        for function in referencing:
            current = per_function.get(function)
            if current is None:
                continue
            if all(existing[1] != label for existing in current.crypto):
                per_function[function] = replace(current, crypto=current.crypto + ((table_address, label),))
    scanned = tuple(address for address, _name, _instructions, _memory in functions)
    return CodeSignals(
        functions=tuple(item for item in per_function.values() if not item.empty),
        hash_algorithm=algorithm,
        tables=tuple(tables),
        scanned_functions=len(scanned),
        scanned_addresses=scanned,
        hash_tables=hash_tables,
    )


def format_code_signals(signals: Optional[CodeSignals], limit: int = 8) -> str:
    """Compact Triage-tab block (one line per function, strongest first)."""
    if signals is None or not signals.scanned_functions:
        return ""
    if not signals.functions:
        return "Code signals: {0} author function(s) scanned - no decoders, API hashing, crypto constants or anti-analysis instructions.".format(
            signals.scanned_functions)
    lines = ["Code signals ({0} author function(s) scanned{1}):".format(
        signals.scanned_functions, ", API hash algorithm " + signals.hash_algorithm if signals.hash_algorithm else "")]
    tables = getattr(signals, "hash_tables", ()) or ()
    if tables:
        apis = sum(len(table.entries) for table in tables)
        dlls = list(dict.fromkeys(entry[2].split("!", 1)[0] for table in tables for entry in table.entries))
        lines.append("  API hash tables in data: {0} table(s), {1} API(s) from {2} ({3}) at {4}".format(
            len(tables), apis, ", ".join(dlls[:8]), tables[0].algorithm,
            ", ".join("0x{0:X}".format(table.start) for table in tables[:6])))

    def weight(item: FunctionSignals) -> Tuple[int, int]:
        return (-(3 * len(item.api_hashes) + 3 * len(item.anti_analysis) + 2 * len(item.decoded_strings) + len(item.crypto)), item.address)

    for item in sorted(signals.functions, key=weight)[:limit]:
        parts = []
        if item.api_hashes:
            parts.append("resolves {0}".format(", ".join(entry[3].split("!", 1)[-1] for entry in item.api_hashes[:4])))
        if item.anti_analysis:
            parts.append("; ".join(entry[1] for entry in item.anti_analysis[:3]))
        if item.decoded_strings:
            parts.append("decodes " + ", ".join('"{0}"'.format(entry[1][:40]) for entry in item.decoded_strings[:3]))
        if item.crypto:
            parts.append(", ".join(dict.fromkeys(entry[1] for entry in item.crypto[:3])))
        lines.append("  0x{0:X}  {1:<30} {2}".format(item.address, item.name[:30], " | ".join(parts)))
    if len(signals.functions) > limit:
        lines.append("  … {0} more function(s) with signals".format(len(signals.functions) - limit))
    return "\n".join(lines)


__all__ = [
    "CRYPTO_IMMEDIATES", "CRYPTO_TABLES", "CodeSignals", "FunctionSignals", "analyse_function", "build_code_signals",
    "format_code_signals", "resolve_hashes",
]

104	def _hash_tables() -> Dict[str, Dict[int, str]]:
105	    global _HASH_TABLES
106	    if _HASH_TABLES is not None:
107	        return _HASH_TABLES
108	    tables: Dict[str, Dict[int, str]] = {}
109	    # The catalogue lists "dll!Function"; hash the function part (and, for ROR13, the pair).
110	    pairs: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
111	    for entry in deob.known_api_names():
112	        if not entry or not entry.isascii():
113	            continue
114	        dll, _, func = entry.rpartition("!")
115	        pairs.append((dll or "kernel32.dll", func))
116	    dlls = [dll for dll in deob.known_dll_names() if dll.isascii()]
117	    for algorithm in deob.HASH_ALGORITHMS:
118	        table: Dict[int, str] = {}
119	        for dll, func in pairs:
120	            for variant in dict.fromkeys((func, func.lower(), func.upper())):
121	                try:
122	                    table.setdefault(deob.hash_name(variant, algorithm), dll + "!" + func)
123	                except deob.DeobfuscationInputError:
124	                    continue
125	            if algorithm == "ror13":
126	                # Metasploit-style hashes combine the module name with the function name
127	                # (upper-cased module name in the original; some loaders lower-case it).
128	                for module in dict.fromkeys([dll] + dlls):
129	                    for case in ("upper", "lower"):
130	                        try:
131	                            table.setdefault(deob.hash_api(module, func, "ror13", case), module + "!" + func)
132	                        except deob.DeobfuscationInputError:
133	                            continue
134	        tables[algorithm] = {value: name for value, name in table.items() if value not in _HASH_IGNORE and value > 0xFFFF}
135	    _HASH_TABLES = tables
136	    return tables

246	def _anti_analysis(parsed: Sequence[deob.ParsedInstruction], raw: Sequence[Instruction]) -> List[Tuple[int, str]]:

253	        for label, pattern in _ANTI_PATTERNS:
254	            if label in seen:

256	            if label == "rdtsc timing check" and rdtsc_count < 2:
257	                continue

259	                if label.startswith("PEB access"):
260	                    # Only a PEB read followed by a debug-flag field is an anti-debug check.
261	                    window = " ".join((entry.text or "").lower() for entry in raw[index:index + 4])

278	                seen.add("VMware backdoor magic 'VMXh'")

282	_RESULT_REGISTERS = frozenset({"rax", "eax"})
283	POINTER_STORE_WINDOW = 14

285	
286	def _pointer_stores(parsed: Sequence[deob.ParsedInstruction], memory_operands: Mapping[int, Sequence[int]],
287	                    candidate_eas: Set[int]) -> Dict[int, int]:
288	    """Hash instruction -> global written with the resolver's return value.
289	
290	    Pattern (both bitnesses): the hash constant is loaded or pushed, a call
291	    follows, and the call's result (``rax``/``eax``) is stored to a global
292	    within a few instructions: ``mov ecx, 0x726774C`` / ``call resolve`` /
293	    ``mov cs:qword_140012345, rax``.
294	    """
295	    stores: Dict[int, int] = {}
296	    for index, item in enumerate(parsed):
297	        if item.address not in candidate_eas:
298	            continue
299	        seen_call = False
300	        for follower in parsed[index + 1: index + 1 + POINTER_STORE_WINDOW]:
301	            if follower.mnemonic == "call":
302	                if seen_call:
303	                    break  # a second call without a store: not the resolver pattern
304	                seen_call = True
305	                continue
306	            if not seen_call:
307	                continue
308	            operands = [operand.strip().lower() for operand in follower.operands]
309	            # The reader records only memory operands that point at real data (> 0x1000),
310	            # so stack stores ("mov [rbp+var_8], rax") never qualify.
311	            targets = list(memory_operands.get(follower.address, ()))
312	            if follower.mnemonic == "mov" and len(operands) == 2 and operands[1] in _RESULT_REGISTERS and targets:
313	                stores[item.address] = targets[0]
314	                break
315	            if operands and operands[0] in _RESULT_REGISTERS:
316	                break  # the result register is overwritten before any store
317	    return stores

320	def analyse_function(
321	    address: int,
322	    name: str,
323	    instructions: Sequence[Instruction],
324	    memory_operands: Mapping[int, Sequence[int]] = {},
325	    read_bytes: Optional[Callable[[int, int], Optional[bytes]]] = None,
326	    is_data_address: Optional[Callable[[int], bool]] = None,
327	) -> Tuple[FunctionSignals, List[Tuple[int, int]]]:
328	    """Signals of one function plus raw (instruction address, immediate) hash candidates.
329	
330	    ``memory_operands`` maps an instruction address to the data addresses its
331	    operands reference (from IDA); with ``read_bytes`` it lets XOR loops be
332	    decoded from their real buffer.
333	    """
334	    items = tuple(instructions)[: deob.MAX_OUTPUT_ITEMS]
335	    parsed = [deob.parse_instruction(item) for item in items]
336	    decoded: List[Tuple[int, str, str]] = []
337	    for stack in deob.extract_stack_strings(items):
338	        method = getattr(stack, "method", "")
339	        decoded.append((stack.start_address, stack.text,
340	                        "stack string ({0}{1})".format(stack.encoding, ", " + method if method else "")))
341	
342	    if read_bytes is not None:
343	        for loop in deob.detect_xor_loop(items):
344	            if loop.key_hint is None or not 0 < (loop.key_hint & 0xFFFFFFFF) <= 0xFF:
345	                continue
346	            buffers = [target for ea in range(loop.start_address - 64, loop.end_address + 1)
347	                       for target in memory_operands.get(ea, ()) if is_data_address is None or is_data_address(target)]
348	            for buffer in dict.fromkeys(buffers):
349	                raw = read_bytes(buffer, 512)
350	                if not raw:
351	                    continue
352	                plain = deob.decode_xor(raw, bytes([loop.key_hint & 0xFF]))
353	                text = plain.split(b"\x00", 1)[0]
354	                # A key applied to an empty / unrelated buffer gives "kkkk…" or noise: require real text.
355	                if len(text) >= 4 and deob.printable_ratio(text) >= 0.95 and deob.looks_like_text(text.decode("latin-1")):
356	                    decoded.append((buffer, text.decode("latin-1"), "single-byte XOR 0x{0:02X} (loop 0x{1:X})".format(loop.key_hint & 0xFF, loop.start_address)))
357	                    break
358	
359	    crypto: List[Tuple[int, str]] = []
360	    candidates: List[Tuple[int, int]] = []
361	    seen_crypto: Set[str] = set()
362	    for ea, value, mnemonic in _immediates(parsed):
363	        label = CRYPTO_IMMEDIATES.get(value)
364	        if label is not None and label not in seen_crypto:
365	            crypto.append((ea, label))
366	            seen_crypto.add(label)
367	        elif mnemonic in ("cmp", "mov", "push", "xor", "sub", "add", "test") and value > 0xFFFF and value not in _HASH_IGNORE:
368	            candidates.append((ea, value))
369	    if any(item.mnemonic == "ror" and any(deob.parse_immediate(op) == 13 for op in item.operands[1:]) for item in parsed):
370	        crypto.append((next(item.address for item in parsed if item.mnemonic == "ror"), "ROR-13 hashing loop (API hashing)"))
371	
372	    stores = _pointer_stores(parsed, memory_operands, {ea for ea, _value in candidates})

393	def _pe_walk(parsed: Sequence[deob.ParsedInstruction]) -> Tuple[Tuple[int, str], ...]:
394	    """Export-table walking without the import table.
395	
396	    Needs the export-directory read (``[nt+78h]`` PE32 / ``[nt+88h]`` PE32+) and either an
397	    ``MZ`` / ``PE`` signature compare, or an ``e_lfanew`` (``+3Ch``) read plus at least three of
398	    the export-directory fields (+18h/+1Ch/+20h/+24h) - a combination ordinary structures do not
399	    produce. The CRT's own image checks compare MZ/PE but never read the export directory.
400	    """
401	    export = signature = lfanew = None
402	    fields = set()
403	    for item in parsed:
404	        # Stack slots ([rsp+78h], [ebp+20h]) share these offsets; PE structures are reached through a
405	        # module-base register, never the frame.
406	        operands = " ".join(op for op in item.operands if not re.search(r"\[(?:[er]?[sb]p)\b", op))
407	        if export is None and _EXPORT_DIR.search(operands) and item.mnemonic in ("mov", "add", "lea"):
408	            export = item.address
409	        if lfanew is None and _LFANEW.search(operands) and item.mnemonic in ("mov", "add", "movsxd", "lea"):
410	            lfanew = item.address
411	        if item.mnemonic in ("mov", "add", "lea", "movzx", "cmp"):
412	            fields.update(offset for offset, pattern in _EXPORT_FIELDS.items() if pattern.search(operands))
413	        if signature is None and item.mnemonic == "cmp" and len(item.operands) == 2:
414	            value = deob.parse_immediate(item.operands[1])
415	            if value in (0x5A4D, 0x4550) or item.operands[1] in ("'zm'", "'mz'", "'ep'"):
416	                signature = item.address
417	    # The export directory's own fields must be read: a signature compare alone is what the CRT's
418	    # image checks and delay-load helpers do too.
419	    if export is None or len(fields) < 3 or (signature is None and lfanew is None):
420	        return ()
421	    found = [(export, "export directory read (e_lfanew+78h/88h)")]
422	    if signature is not None:
423	        found.append((signature, "MZ / PE signature compare"))
424	    if lfanew is not None:
425	        found.append((lfanew, "e_lfanew (+3Ch) read"))
426	    return tuple(found)

474	def find_hash_tables(
475	    blobs: Sequence[Tuple[int, bytes]],
476	    references_to: Optional[Callable[[int], Sequence[int]]] = None,
477	    minimum_hits: int = MIN_TABLE_HASH_HITS,
478	) -> Tuple[Optional[str], Tuple[HashTable, ...]]:
479	    """Find API-hash tables in data: aligned dwords that match one algorithm's catalogue hashes.
480	
481	    The algorithm with the most *distinct* hits wins (>= ``minimum_hits``); its hits are grouped
482	    into tables (gaps up to ``TABLE_MAX_GAP_BYTES``) and each table is linked to the functions
483	    that reference any of its entries (``references_to(address)`` -> function starts).
484	    """
485	    index = _hash_index()
486	    hits: List[Tuple[int, int, Tuple[Tuple[str, str], ...]]] = []
487	    budget = MAX_HASH_SCAN_BYTES
488	    for start, blob in blobs:
489	        if not blob or budget <= 0:
490	            continue
491	        data = bytes(blob[: budget])
492	        budget -= len(data)
493	        usable = len(data) - (len(data) % 4)
494	        for offset in range(0, usable, 4):
495	            value = int.from_bytes(data[offset: offset + 4], "little")
496	            found = index.get(value)
497	            if found:
498	                hits.append((start + offset, value, found))
499	    counts: Dict[str, set] = {}
500	    for _address, value, found in hits:
501	        for algorithm, _api in found:
502	            counts.setdefault(algorithm, set()).add(value)
503	    if not counts:
504	        return None, ()
505	    algorithm = max(counts, key=lambda name: (len(counts[name]), name))
506	    if len(counts[algorithm]) < minimum_hits:
507	        return None, ()
508	    chosen = [(address, value, next(api for alg, api in found if alg == algorithm))
509	              for address, value, found in hits if any(alg == algorithm for alg, _api in found)]
510	    tables: List[HashTable] = []
511	    run: List[Tuple[int, int, str]] = []
512	
513	    def close() -> None:
514	        if len(run) >= 2:
515	            start, end = run[0][0], run[-1][0] + 4
516	            functions: List[int] = []
517	            if references_to is not None:
518	                for address in range(max(0, start - TABLE_MAX_GAP_BYTES), end, 4):
519	                    for function in references_to(address) or ():
520	                        if function not in functions:
521	                            functions.append(function)
522	            tables.append(HashTable(start, end, algorithm, tuple(run), (end - start) // 4 - len(run), tuple(functions)))
523	        del run[:]
524	
525	    for entry in chosen:
526	        if run and entry[0] - run[-1][0] > TABLE_MAX_GAP_BYTES:
527	            close()
528	        run.append(entry)
529	    close()
530	    return algorithm, tuple(tables)
